assumptions: Nominal ideal R1 and C1, no ADC load or parasitics.
Ideal 0-to-1 V step at /IN; C1 initially at 0 V.
These assumptions establish an unloaded baseline only, not the unspecified switched ADC operating condition.
symbolic_charge_sharing: If an ideal switch connects a sampling capacitor Cs initially at Vs to C1 at Vminus, charge conservation gives Vplus=(C1*Vminus+Cs*Vs)/(C1+Cs). No Cs, Vs, Rsw or connection times assigned; this is an explanatory limiting relation, not an ADC model.
